title: Fix 298
acceptance_criteria: When a commit between the change's base commit and HEAD holds a change both open under .specsync/changes/<id>/ and archived under .specsync/archive/changes/<date>-<id>/, chough change ship refuses before it runs SpecSync's review or ship, naming the commit, the duplicated change and how to recover, with every file unchanged and no native step run; without such a commit the ship runs as before. The docs say the check is interim until SpecSync's preflight (CorvidLabs/spec-sync#1082).

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are listed as plain text in tasks.md, not as checkboxes, and the delta is frozen at approval. SpecSync owns terminal-evidence validity; this check is interim until its preflight (spec-sync#1082). No other lesson or principle constrains it.
